overview.purpose_zh: 这张网络图把团队画成点，把每周的协作请求画成带箭头的线：线的方向是从哪个团队发往哪个团队，标注的数字是请求数量。它回答的是谁在跟谁打交道、请求往哪里流，不是组织架构。
works_zh: 适合看哪些团队收到的请求最多、被谁依赖。
适合发现只出不进的团队，或者两个方向很不平衡的关系。
适合在调整人力或流程前先看协作结构。
uses_zh: 排期会议前说明瓶颈在哪个团队。
向新同事介绍公司内部的依赖关系。

understanding.read_zh: 先读箭头方向，再看线上的数字：一条线只表示一个方向的请求。接着看每个点连了几条线、每条线有多粗，找出被依赖最多的团队。最后提醒自己：点的位置是布局算法排出来的，靠上、靠中间都不代表更重要，含义在连线和数字里。

elements.note_zh: 每个点是一个团队，点上的文字是团队名称。
箭头从发出方指向接收方，方向读反了结论就会反。
线上的数字是每周请求数，是判断哪条关系最重的依据。
点的位置由布局算法决定，换一种布局会变，不携带数值含义。

look_for_zh: 哪个点收到的箭头最多、数字最大。
同一对团队之间两个方向的数字差多少。
有没有只发不收的团队。

observations.en: Engineering receives 94 requests a week, more than any other team, and sends 62.
observations.zh: Engineering 每周收到 94 个请求，比其他团队都多，同时发出 62 个。

observations.en: Design receives 82 and sends 62, so together with Engineering it carries most of the traffic.
observations.zh: Design 收到 82 个、发出 62 个，和 Engineering 一起承担了大部分请求。

observations.en: The strongest single link runs from Design to Engineering at 42; the reverse direction carries 28.
observations.zh: 最强的一条单向连线从 Design 指向 Engineering，共 42 个；反方向只有 28 个。

observations.en: Design and Engineering send the same number of requests, 62 each.
observations.zh: Design 和 Engineering 发出的请求一样多，各 62 个。

observations.en: Marketing and Support only send requests, 40 and 26, and receive none.
observations.zh: Marketing 和 Support 只发请求，分别是 40 和 26 个，没有收到任何请求。

observations.en: Product is almost balanced: 61 sent and 62 received.
observations.zh: Product 几乎收支平衡：发出 61 个，收到 62 个。

observations.en: QA receives 34 requests, all of them from Engineering, and the smallest link on the chart is QA to Product at 9.
observations.zh: QA 收到 34 个请求，全部来自 Engineering；全图最细的连线是 QA 发给 Product 的 9 个。

describe.en: The flow of requests runs mainly toward Engineering and Design: Engineering receives 94 a week and Design 82.
describe.zh: 请求主要流向 Engineering 和 Design：Engineering 每周收到 94 个，Design 收到 82 个。
describe.pattern: the flow of + noun + from ... to ... / flow into + place
alternatives: Most requests end up in the two largest teams.
The arrows point toward Engineering and Design more than anywhere else.
describe.note_zh: flow 强调方向和数量，和 process 不同：这里不关心步骤顺序，只关心请求去了谁那里。

describe.en: The most noticeable feature is the imbalance between Design and Engineering: 42 requests go one way and 28 the other.
describe.zh: 最引人注意的是 Design 和 Engineering 之间的不平衡：一个方向 42 个请求，另一个方向只有 28 个。
describe.pattern: The most noticeable feature is + noun phrase
alternatives: The heaviest link is also a one-sided one.
Design asks Engineering for more than it gets back.
describe.note_zh: 先点出最强的一条线，再用反方向的数字说明它不对称，一句话里有两个证据。

describe.en: Product sends twice as many requests to Design as Marketing does: 36 against 18.
describe.zh: Product 发给 Design 的请求是 Marketing 的两倍：36 对 18。
describe.pattern: A + be + twice as much as + B / twice the + noun
alternatives: Product's 36 requests to Design double Marketing's 18.
Design receives 36 from Product and 18 from Marketing.
describe.note_zh: 可数的请求数用 twice as many as；不可数的流量、时间才用 twice as much as。

describe.en: Individual links range between 9 and 42 requests a week.
describe.zh: 单条连线每周的请求量在 9 到 42 之间。
alternatives: The smallest link carries 9 requests and the largest 42.
describe.note_zh: 先给全图的区间，再点出最大和最小两条线，读者马上知道范围有多宽。

describe.en: What stands out is that Marketing and Support never appear as targets, only as senders.
describe.zh: 最突出的是 Marketing 和 Support 从来不作为接收方出现，只出现在发出端。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun phrase
alternatives: Two teams only give, never receive.
The arrows leave Marketing and Support but never point to them.
describe.note_zh: 没有数字也能是一句结论；它描述的是结构，不是某一个值。

describe.en: Design receives more requests than it sends, 82 against 62, and so does Engineering, 94 against 62.
describe.zh: Design 收到的请求多于发出的，82 对 62；Engineering 也一样，94 对 62。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure
alternatives: Both large teams take in more than they send out.
Incoming traffic exceeds outgoing traffic for Design and Engineering.
describe.note_zh: 把两个团队放进同一句时，数字顺序要和名字顺序一一对应，否则读者会配错。

academic.en: The network diagram maps weekly requests among six teams. Engineering and Design are the principal recipients, with 94 requests for Engineering and 82 for Design, although each team dispatches 62. The strongest directed edge runs from Design to Engineering at 42, whereas the reverse direction carries 28. Product is nearly balanced, with 61 sent and 62 received, and all 34 requests received by QA originate with Engineering. Marketing and Support appear solely as senders, at 40 and 26. Node placement is determined by the layout algorithm and should not be interpreted as a ranking; direction and edge values convey the meaning.
academic.zh: 这张网络图展示六个团队之间的每周请求。Engineering 和 Design 是主要的接收方，Engineering 收到 94 个，Design 收到 82 个，不过两个团队各自发出 62 个。最强的一条有向线从 Design 指向 Engineering，共 42 个，反方向是 28 个。Product 基本平衡，发出 61 个、收到 62 个；QA 收到的 34 个请求全部来自 Engineering。Marketing 和 Support 只作为发出方出现，分别是 40 和 26 个。节点位置由布局算法决定，不应被当成排名；方向和连线上的数值才是含义所在。

business.en: Our collaboration load is concentrated in two teams. Engineering takes in 94 requests a week and Design 82, while each of them sends 62. The heaviest link is Design to Engineering at 42, with only 28 coming back, so the exchange is uneven. Product is almost balanced at 61 out and 62 in, and QA receives 34, all from Engineering. Marketing and Support only send, at 40 and 26, which makes them easy to miss when we plan capacity. We should treat positions on the chart as layout, not ranking, and check those two sender teams explicitly.
business.zh: 我们的协作负担集中在两个团队。Engineering 每周收到 94 个请求，Design 收到 82 个，而它们各自发出 62 个。最重的一条线是 Design 发往 Engineering 的 42 个，回来的只有 28 个，往来并不对等。Product 几乎是平衡的，发出 61 个、收到 62 个；QA 收到 34 个，全部来自 Engineering。Marketing 和 Support 只发不收，分别是 40 和 26 个，做人力规划时很容易漏掉。我们应该把图上的位置只当排版看，并单独核对这两个只发请求的团队。

simple.en: Each dot is a team. Each line is a request going from one team to another. Engineering gets 94 requests a week. Design gets 82, so those two dots carry the most traffic. Design and Engineering each send 62. Marketing and Support only send requests, 40 and 26. The place where a dot sits is just the layout. The arrows and the numbers are the real story.
simple.zh: 每个点是团队。每条线是从一个团队发往另一个团队的请求。Engineering 每周收到 94 个请求。Design 收到 82 个，所以这两个点承载的请求最多。Design 和 Engineering 各自发出 62 个。Marketing 和 Support 只发请求，分别是 40 和 26 个。点放在哪里只是排版。箭头和数字才是真正要看的东西。

language_notes.body_zh: 说连线一定要带方向：from A to B，或者 A sends ... to B。箭头从发出方指向接收方。不要写 between A to B；between 后面接两个对象时用 and。
examples: Design sends 42 requests to Engineering each week.
The 42 requests go from Design to Engineering.

language_notes.title_en: More connections is not more traffic
language_notes.body_zh: 一个团队连了几个团队，和它收到多少请求是两回事。连得多的团队不一定最忙，连得少的也可能每条线都很粗。读图时先看数字和线的粗细，再数连线。
examples: Design touches three other teams and receives 82 requests; Product touches five and receives 62.
Count the links, then read the values; they measure different things.

language_notes.body_zh: 网络图的点位置由布局算法决定，靠近中心、在顶部都没有含义；同一个数据集换一种布局，点的位置会变。描述时把注意力放在箭头方向、连线数量和数值上，不要写 the most central team，除非你说的是连接数。
examples: A node near the middle is not automatically the most important.
Read the arrows and values, not the position.
